rule: At the start of every task, evaluate the task against the parameters below, then load ONLY the skills whose triggers match your evaluation. Never load all skills.

parameters.name: task_kind
parameters.description: What kind of security task is this?

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Which attack surface is in focus?

skills.purpose: Structured security audit workflow over codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is audit or when surface is whole_codebase (full or focused vulnerability review).

skills.purpose: Hardening patterns for a specific attack surface: input, auth, storage, integrations.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is hardening and surface is input_handling, auth, storage, or integration.

skills.purpose: Fresh-context adversarial review before a security claim/fix stands.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is verification or when a security claim or fix is about to be accepted.

skills.purpose: Multi-axis code quality assessment alongside security findings.
skills.triggers: Load when task_kind is review or when assessing code quality/posture.
